{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:17.860

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:38.299

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Right, so there's like an esoteric truth and an exoteric truth.

}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = It's the sun and the blah, blah, blah, blah, blah.

    | timestamp = 00:25:43.819
    | text      = Yeah that's my bar for all world religions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:47.460
    | text      = Catch a leprechaun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:48.460
    | text      = I don't like to shit on people's fun, you know, in terms of magic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:55.700
    | text      = I think that having some fun with the world is pretty necessary.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:01.660
    | text      = And I think that however you get it, I'm not gonna sit here and be like, you witches can't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:06.660
    | text      = do shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:07.660
    | text      = That seems like a boring and assholish way to go about life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:11.200
    | text      = You're not bothering me, I'm not bothering you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:13.099
    | text      = At the same time, I think that if someone makes an affirmative statement that they can
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:18.220
    | text      = do magic, I must see the magic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:21.059
    | text      = One hundred percent, you gotta do it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:23.700
    | text      = And if you're going to insist on some kind of world that I must adhere to based on that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:29.660
    | text      = magic, I need to see you shoot lightning bolts or something.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:33.180
    | text      = I'll join your team if you shoot lightning bolts.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:35.579
    | text      = I think of it as a positive.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:37.220
    | text      = If you can shoot lightning bolts, I'm on your team.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:39.619
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:40.619
    | text      = I'll join a lightning bolt team.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:43.380
    | text      = Why not?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:44.380
    | text      = They can shoot lightning bolts.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:45.619
    | text      = That sounds fun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:47.900
    | text      = A lot of my beliefs about the world are based on sort of truths that we've uncovered.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:55.420
    | text      = And a lot of those are called into question when someone can shoot lightning out of their
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:58.339
    | text      = hands.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:59.339
    | text      = Yeah, everything changes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:00.339
    | text      = And so I will reassess some of my prior assumptions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Totally.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:04.019
    | text      = Some of the baselines.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:05.019
    | text      = I think it's fair.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:06.019
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:07.019
    | text      = I'm coming into the... with open hearts and open eyes, I want you to shoot lightning.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:11.140
    | text      = I want to be on your team.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:12.980
    | text      = Because currently my team has a dearth of lightning shooters.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:17.059
    | text      = And I can handle at least one or two of them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:18.700
    | text      = I'll even let you shoot me with the lightning a little bit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:20.859
    | text      = Totally.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:21.859
    | text      = You now get a little jolt.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:22.859
    | text      = Hey, that'd be fun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:23.859
    | text      = People do that for Zuck stuff too.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:26.059
    | text      = You know, let's have a good time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:29.099
    | text      = So you mentioned Typhon in there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:32.220
    | text      = And that's just another member of the Egyptian gods and stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:38.859
    | text      = It will be used as a stand-in for Christianity.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:43.500
    | text      = So that's the metaphor that it is going to take.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:47.059
    | text      = It's the enemy of the mystery religions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:50.579
    | text      = They don't like Typhon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:51.579
    | text      = Gotcha.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:52.579
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:53.579
    | text      = Weird.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:54.579
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:55.579
    | text      = They got... they got to... like...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:57.500
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:58.500
    | text      = If you don't have any real gods, and your idea is that the intellect is going to do
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:04.059
    | text      = the thing, how is Christianity a perversion of that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:08.420
    | text      = You know what I mean?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:11.059
    | text      = I think that they would view it as a perversion of it because it's a limiting... it's a co-opting
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:18.420
    | text      = of this myth... mystical truth.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:22.299
    | text      = But it does kind of run counter to what Bill has already said too, which is the exoteric
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:28.299
    | text      = truth of like, if you want to believe that these images are humans, are individuals like
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:36.920
    | text      = Jesus, per se, then the Mystery School should have no problem with that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:41.759
    | text      = Yeah, it feels...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:42.759
    | text      = They seem to have a problem with Christianity, but not with all the other personifications
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:48.000
    | text      = of hidden truths.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:50.000
    | text      = Which is strange.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:51.000
    | text      = It almost seems like he has a persecution complex.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:54.039
    | text      = It's almost like he created an enemy specifically for himself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:56.799
    | text      = Yeah, almost like he's fighting ghosts and has figured out how to lie about them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:00.160
    | text      = Strange.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:01.160
    | text      = Cool.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:02.160
    | text      = But do you want to pay taxes?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:03.259
    | text      = Of course you don't.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:04.380
    | text      = Send Bill some money.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:06.059
    | text      = So a lot of the people who have similar beliefs to Bill, and maybe some of the people who
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:12.059
    | text      = have helped him not feel so alone in the quiet hours of the night, don't like Jewish people
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:17.019
    | text      = so much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:19.019
    | text      = And a part of that is that the Masonic master builder Hyrum the Bith is seen as Jewish.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:27.900
    | text      = And so Bill has to counter this, or address this here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:32.900
    | text      = The Mabelite Typhon is the spirit of dissension and discord that breaks up unity of purpose
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:37.980
    | text      = by setting factions against each other so that great issues lose the name of action.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:44.460
    | text      = The desire for riches, pomp, power and—listen to this, folks—sovereignty by which this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:51.380
    | text      = evil genius was obsessed, reveals the temptation by which humanity is deflected from its ultimate
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:58.140
    | text      = goal and led into the byways of sorrow and despair.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:02.940
    | text      = Typhon, the queen of Ethiopia, and the seventy-two conspirators represent the three destructive
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:09.140
    | text      = powers preserved to modern Freemasonry as the murderers of the master builder Hyrum
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:17.140
    | text      = Abiff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:18.140
    | text      = You will see that Hyrum Abiff was never murdered.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:20.819
    | text      = In fact, in the Bible you will see that when the Temple of Solomon was completed, he went
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:25.299
    | text      = back home to Tyre.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:27.339
    | text      = But in the Freemason legend, Hyrum Abiff, the master builder, was killed and the Temple
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:32.579
    | text      = was never completed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:34.500
    | text      = So everybody is blaming all of this upon the Jews.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:38.460
    | text      = It is not the Jews, folks, because all of this is a front.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:44.299
    | text      = It's symbology for what they really, really mean.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:48.660
    | text      = Hyrum Abiff was really, folks, Jacques de Malay of the Knights Templar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:58.299
    | text      = All of this will make much more sense to you in several shows down the road because we
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:03.619
    | text      = have lots and lots of information to go through before you put it all together.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:09.619
    | text      = I guarantee this will not make sense a couple shows from now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:13.819
    | text      = There's no way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:14.819
    | text      = No, you're going to tie all this together.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:18.220
    | text      = There's actually a point where Bill is like, it's not the Jews, it's some Jews.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:22.059
    | text      = Nailed it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:23.059
    | text      = Nailed it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:24.059
    | text      = There we go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:25.059
    | text      = There we go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:26.059
    | text      = Yeah, there is a certain element of tap the sign to it's not the Jews.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:29.220
    | text      = You say, ah, tap the sign, it's not the Jews this time, god damn it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:32.980
    | text      = So Hyrum Abiff is a mythical character in Masonic lore who is the chief architect of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:37.740
    | text      = Solomon's Temple.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:39.099
    | text      = He gets confronted by three fellow builders who demand to know his architectural secrets.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:44.299
    | text      = What are the master mason's secrets?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:45.740
    | text      = Right, right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:46.980
    | text      = But he refuses to tell them what he knows, so they kill him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:50.660
    | text      = The idea is supposed to be that he was the carrier of the secret Masonic word and that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:55.380
    | text      = that secret died with him and was replaced by a fill-in word and the Masonic tradition
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:03.859
    | text      = from then on doesn't have the same secret that Hyrum Abiff had.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:10.059
    | text      = But what they have is good enough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:12.339
    | text      = Jacques de Molay was the last head of the Knights Templar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:16.099
    | text      = There's no real way that these two figures can be the same person, but...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:20.660
    | text      = Well, one isn't real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:23.660
    | text      = Timeline's a little strange, but in the 1700s some branches of Freemasonry began to believe
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:29.740
    | text      = that de Molay, while he was in charge of the Knights Templar, had come across some secret
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:34.299
    | text      = information at Solomon's Temple.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:36.660
    | text      = He had discovered the stuff that was supposed to have died with Hyrum Abiff and those secrets
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:40.680
    | text      = were then passed down from him through Masonic tradition.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:45.019
    | text      = So that's where this is coming from, that they're the same person.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:47.380
    | text      = Last Crusade shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:48.380
    | text      = Gotcha.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:49.380
    | text      = And a lot of this is still just from that Manly P. Hall book.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:51.779
    | text      = He's really just reading that stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:54.099
    | text      = And that's why it kind of doesn't make sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:56.740
    | text      = Like a lot of it is...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:59.380
    | text      = Some of it, naturally, is I'm playing clips, I'm not playing the whole thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:05.299
    | text      = But even if you listen to the whole thing, a lot of it does not connect.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:10.420
    | text      = Because he's taking just chunks of this book and reading it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:15.220
    | text      = And it's not going to make sense in a couple episodes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:19.579
    | text      = I don't think it will.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:20.579
    | text      = I have faith there will be something.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:22.940
    | text      = Maybe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:24.259
    | text      = Here's what I always like about whenever people are talking about somebody else's religion,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:29.740
    | text      = whether it's real or fake.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:33.059
    | text      = They're always taking it very seriously.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:35.019
    | text      = Like they never really account for, are there like Christmas and Easter mystery Babylon
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:39.579
    | text      = people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:40.579
    | text      = People who don't really...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:42.019
    | text      = They're culturally mystery Babylon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:44.500
    | text      = You know like, hey man, we don't actually believe in all this sun and solar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:48.619
    | text      = We don't even think false cognates make any sense either.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:50.980
    | text      = But you know, you just go along to get along.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:53.460
    | text      = This is just how I was raised.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:54.460
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:55.460
    | text      = I was raised in mystery Babylon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:56.460
    | text      = Like, why are you judging me for this?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:58.660
    | text      = I'm not like, you know?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:00.059
    | text      = Uh huh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:01.059
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:02.059
    | text      = I don't want to destroy you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:03.460
    | text      = I just...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:04.460
    | text      = You're the one making us enemies.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:07.940
    | text      = Do you understand you're the one making us enemies?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:10.659
    | text      = I am over here just like having a good time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:14.300
    | text      = This is you, Bill.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:15.300
    | text      = Yeah, Bill.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:16.300
    | text      = You're trying to do crusades, Bill.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:17.300
    | text      = Leave us alone.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:18.300
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:19.300
    | text      = I do think that there is something ultimately incredibly funny if we go through all of this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:24.579
